title: 历史建筑与文化保护词汇
goal: 掌握建筑与保护词汇并对应历史信息

points.label: 理解建筑与保护的常用词
准确对应建筑历史和保护信息

sources.title: 全国大学英语四、六级考试大纲（2016年修订版）
sources.used: 课程内容所依据的考试大纲

body.p: 建筑介绍涉及构造、历史用途和保护措施。译文须区分过去和现在的用途，并对应修缮对象。例：Workers repair the roof. 表示修理屋顶。

cards.title: 词汇表：建筑构成
rows: A stone column supports the roof.
The floor is made of wood.
A tower stands beside the gate.
The wall is built of brick.
The steps are made of stone.

cards.title: 词汇表：历史用途
rows: The temple stands on a hill.
The hall once served as a school.
The square was once a market.
Grain was kept in the storehouse.
The building is now a museum.

cards.title: 词汇表：保护修缮
rows: The site is part of local heritage.
Rain caused damage to the wall.
A loose tile fell from the roof.
The site is open to visitors.

body.p: 中文：临河镇的一座老宅建于十九世纪，木门通向中央庭院。它原来是一户人家的住所，后来成为社区活动场所。近年来，工作人员修补屋顶并更换破损瓦片，同时保留原有木门。如今，居民在院内举办手工艺展览。

body.box: An old house in Linhe Town was built in the nineteenth century. A wooden gate leads to its central courtyard. Once a family residence, it later became a place for community activities. In recent years, workers have repaired the roof and replaced damaged tiles while keeping the original wooden gate. Residents now hold craft exhibitions in the courtyard.

body.p: once 和 later 区分用途变化；repaired 对应屋顶，replaced 对应瓦片。keeping the original wooden gate 对应保留原有木门。

groups.fill: An old building stands beside a river. Its ro{of} is covered with ti{les}, and a stone wa{ll} surrounds the courtyard. The ga{te} opens onto a path. The building once served as a sch{ool}, but today it is a mus{eum}. Workers rep{air} damaged parts and pro{tect} the original wood. They also rec{ord} their work so that future staff can main{tain} the building. Visitors can learn about its history from displays in the main hall and walk through the courtyard during opening hours.

groups.text: 中文：虚构的南桥镇有一座旧仓库，过去用于存粮，现在用于展览。工人修复了砖墙，保留了原来的石门。建筑旁边有一个庭院，居民可以在那里观看手工艺展示。工作人员记录修缮过程，供今后的维护参考。

items.stem: What was the building used for in the past?
items.why: 原文说仓库过去用于存粮，对应第一项。用于展览是现在的用途。
原文说工人修复了砖墙，对应第二项。

items.stem: What happened to the stone gate?
options: It was rebuilt with new bricks.
It was restored along with the wall.
It was left in its original form.
It was moved into the courtyard.
items.why: 原文说保留原来的石门，对应第三项。

items.stem: Where can residents view craft displays?
items.why: 原文说居民可在建筑旁的庭院观看手工艺展示，对应第四项。

items.stem: Why do staff record the repair work?
options: To decide whether to keep the gate
To show the work in the exhibitions
items.why: 原文说记录修缮过程供今后的维护参考，对应第一项。

groups.fill: A village has an old public building. A wide cour{tyard} lies behind its wooden ga{te}. A stone wa{ll} surrounds the building, and a tiled ro{of} covers the main hall. The hall once hosted community gathe{rings}, but it now houses an exhib{ition} of tools. Workers rep{air} broken tiles and pres{erve} the wooden door. The building is part of local heri{tage}. Staff also rec{ord} changes so that future repairs can be planned with care. Residents visit the hall to learn about the work of earlier generations.

groups.text: 中文：虚构的青河镇有一座建于十八世纪的建筑。它最初是住宅，后来用作学校，如今是一座博物馆。修缮时，工人修补了屋顶，并保留庭院里的石柱。博物馆通过展览介绍当地手工艺，院子也对居民开放。

items.why: 原文说建筑建于十八世纪，对应第二项。

items.stem: What was the building first used as?
items.why: 原文说明建筑最初是住宅，对应第三项。

items.stem: What use followed its use as a residence?
items.why: 原文说建筑最初是住宅，后来用作学校，对应第四项。博物馆是如今的用途，在学校之后。
原文说工人修补了屋顶，对应第一项。

items.stem: What happened to the stone column?
options: It was repaired and moved indoors.
It was kept in place in the courtyard.
It was replaced by a wooden column.
It was shown in the craft exhibition.
items.why: 原文说保留庭院里的石柱，对应第二项。
